title: Credit Card Rewards Categories
summary: This document lists the eligible transaction rewards categories for Rho-Bank credit cards: Travel, Software, Media, Green/Sustainable, Operations, Transportation, Groceries, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Shopping, and Other (no examples). It also notes each card has its own bonus categories and non-bonus categories earn the default rate, with no reward-rate details provided.
